name: Long March 6A
location_str: LC-9A @ Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center, CHN
slot_a_text: LC-9A is up to 9 launches this year, and 28 since it opened. Its previous launch was 30 days earlier.
slot_b_text: The 47th launch of the year for China's CASC, 617th all time. It works out to a launch every six days. Long March 6A has not lost a mission in 26 flights.
rocket_fact: Rockets are mostly fuel; often over 85% of a launch vehicle's mass is propellant, leaving little room for payload.
